subject: Operations
title: Political Instability
description: A fast breakdown of Political Instability for builders.

hook.text: A coup d'état in a country where you source 40% of your materials. By morning, your supply chain is cut off.

buildup.text: Political instability includes regime changes, civil unrest, policy reversals, and asset nationalization.

discovery.text: Companies assess political risk using country risk scores that rate governance, stability, and rule of law.

twist.text: Stable countries can become unstable quickly. Risk scores are lagging indicators—they reflect the past, not the future.

climax.text: Firms operating in high-risk regions use political risk insurance and maintain alternative sourcing plans.

punchline.text: Governments change. Supply chains must survive the change.

quiz.question: What is political risk insurance?
options: Coverage against losses from political events
